paragraphs.text: Worship, the worshipper, and the worshipped: what sense does it make to talk about differences between them, up in the unsurpassed? Transition — by whom is it effected, for whom, and who exactly is entering what? Here is the stranger part: Maya, which is not different from non-dual consciousness, still stands there as something other. Alas.
And yet all of it is pure, made of nothing but your own experience. So when thoughts come along in vain — don’t.
